explanation.hi: 'had destroyed' Past Perfect है। Passive structure है: Object + had + been + V3 + by + Subject।

question.en: Change the following sentence into Active Voice: 'The letter had been posted by John.'
question.hi: निम्नलिखित वाक्य को Active Voice में बदलें: 'The letter had been posted by John.'

en: John had posted the letter.
John posted the letter.
John has posted the letter.
John was posting the letter.
hi: John had posted the letter.
John posted the letter.
John has posted the letter.
John was posting the letter.

explanation.en: 'had been posted' indicates Past Perfect passive. The active voice uses 'had + V3' (had posted).
explanation.hi: 'had been posted' Past Perfect passive को दर्शाता है। Active voice में 'had + V3' (had posted) का उपयोग होता है।

question.en: Change the following sentence into Passive Voice: 'I shall write a letter.'
question.hi: निम्नलिखित वाक्य को Passive Voice में बदलें: 'I shall write a letter.'

en: A letter will be written by me.
A letter shall be written by me.
A letter would be written by me.
A letter will write by me.
hi: A letter will be written by me.
A letter shall be written by me.
A letter would be written by me.
A letter will write by me.

explanation.en: For third-person nouns like 'a letter', 'will be' is used in the passive form instead of 'shall be'. Structure: Object + will + be + V3 + by + Subject.
explanation.hi: तीसरे पुरुष (third-person) की संज्ञाओं जैसे 'a letter' के लिए, passive रूप में 'shall be' के बजाय 'will be' का उपयोग किया जाता है। Structure: Object + will + be + V3 + by + Subject।

question.en: Change the following sentence into Active Voice: 'The meeting will be addressed by the President.'
question.hi: निम्नलिखित वाक्य को Active Voice में बदलें: 'The meeting will be addressed by the President.'

en: The President will address the meeting.
The President addresses the meeting.
The President will be addressing the meeting.
The President would address the meeting.
hi: The President will address the meeting.
The President addresses the meeting.
The President will be addressing the meeting.
The President would address the meeting.

explanation.en: 'will be addressed' is Future Simple passive. The active voice uses 'will + V1' (will address).
explanation.hi: 'will be addressed' Future Simple passive है। Active voice में 'will + V1' (will address) का उपयोग होता है।

question.en: Change the following sentence into Passive Voice: 'She will have finished the report.'
question.hi: निम्नलिखित वाक्य को Passive Voice में बदलें: 'She will have finished the report.'

en: The report will have been finished by her.
The report will be finished by her.
The report would have been finished by her.
The report will have finished by her.
hi: The report will have been finished by her.
The report will be finished by her.
The report would have been finished by her.
The report will have finished by her.

explanation.en: Future Perfect passive uses: Object + will/shall + have + been + V3 + by + Subject. Here, 'the report' + 'will have been finished'.
explanation.hi: Future Perfect passive में उपयोग होता है: Object + will/shall + have + been + V3 + by + Subject। यहाँ, 'the report' + 'will have been finished' होगा।

question.en: Change the following sentence into Active Voice: 'The match will have been won by us.'
question.hi: निम्नलिखित वाक्य को Active Voice में बदलें: 'The match will have been won by us.'

en: We will have won the match.
We will win the match.
We shall have won the match.
We would have won the match.
hi: We will have won the match.
We will win the match.
We shall have won the match.
We would have won the match.

explanation.en: 'will have been won' indicates Future Perfect passive. The active voice uses 'will/shall have + V3'. 'We' takes 'will/shall have won'. Option A is grammatically standard and correct.
explanation.hi: 'will have been won' Future Perfect passive को दर्शाता है। Active voice में 'will/shall have + V3' का उपयोग होता है। 'We' के साथ 'will/shall have won' का उपयोग होता है। Option A व्याकरण के अनुसार मानक और सही है।

question.en: What is the primary rule for changing active voice to passive voice regarding the subject and object?
question.hi: सब्जेक्ट (subject) और ऑब्जेक्ट (object) के संबंध में एक्टिव वॉइस से पैसिव वॉइस में बदलने का प्राथमिक नियम क्या है?

en: The object of the active verb becomes the subject of the passive verb.
The subject remains the subject.
The object is completely removed.
The subject is changed to an adjective.
hi: The object of the active verb becomes the subject of the passive verb.
The subject remains the subject.
The object is completely removed.
The subject is changed to an adjective.

explanation.en: The basic rule of active-to-passive conversion is to interchange the subject and the object (Object becomes the Subject).
explanation.hi: एक्टिव से पैसिव रूपांतरण का मूल नियम सब्जेक्ट और ऑब्जेक्ट को आपस में बदलना है (ऑब्जेक्ट, सब्जेक्ट बन जाता है)।

question.en: Which form of the main verb is always used in passive voice sentences?
question.hi: पैसिव वॉइस (passive voice) के वाक्यों में मुख्य क्रिया (main verb) के किस रूप का हमेशा उपयोग किया जाता है?

en: Past Participle (V3)
Present Participle (V1+ing)
Simple Past (V2)
Base form (V1)
hi: Past Participle (V3)
Present Participle (V1+ing)
Simple Past (V2)
Base form (V1)

explanation.en: In passive voice, the main verb is always written in its Past Participle (V3) form, regardless of the tense.
explanation.hi: पैसिव वॉइस में, काल (tense) चाहे जो भी हो, मुख्य क्रिया हमेशा अपने Past Participle (V3) रूप में लिखी जाती है।

question.en: Change the following sentence into Passive Voice: 'People speak English all over the world.'
question.hi: निम्नलिखित वाक्य को Passive Voice में बदलें: 'People speak English all over the world.'

en: English is spoken all over the world.
English was spoken all over the world.
English is being spoken all over the world.
English has been spoken all over the world.
hi: English is spoken all over the world.
English was spoken all over the world.
English is being spoken all over the world.
English has been spoken all over the world.

explanation.en: 'speak' is in Present Simple tense. The passive structure is: 'is/am/are + V3'. Since the agent 'by people' is obvious, it is omitted.
explanation.hi: 'speak' Present Simple tense में है। Passive structure 'is/am/are + V3' है। चूंकि कर्ता 'by people' स्पष्ट है, इसलिए इसे हटा दिया जाता है।

question.en: Change the following sentence into Passive Voice: 'Someone stole my pen yesterday.'
question.hi: निम्नलिखित वाक्य को Passive Voice में बदलें: 'Someone stole my pen yesterday.'

en: My pen was stolen yesterday.
My pen is stolen yesterday.
My pen had been stolen yesterday.
My pen was being stolen yesterday.
hi: My pen was stolen yesterday.
My pen is stolen yesterday.
My pen had been stolen yesterday.
My pen was being stolen yesterday.

explanation.en: 'stole' is Past Simple tense. The passive structure is: 'was/were + V3'. Indefinite pronouns like 'someone' are omitted in the passive voice.
explanation.hi: 'stole' Past Simple tense में है। Passive structure 'was/were + V3' है। पैसिव वॉइस में 'someone' जैसे अनिश्चित सर्वनामों (indefinite pronouns) को हटा दिया जाता है।

question.en: Change the following sentence into Passive Voice: 'She is taking a selfie.'
question.hi: निम्नलिखित वाक्य को Passive Voice में बदलें: 'She is taking a selfie.'

en: A selfie is being taken by her.
A selfie is taken by her.
A selfie was being taken by her.
A selfie has been taken by her.
hi: A selfie is being taken by her.
A selfie is taken by her.
A selfie was being taken by her.
A selfie has been taken by her.

explanation.en: 'is taking' is Present Continuous. The passive voice uses 'is/am/are + being + V3'. 'A selfie' is singular, so we use 'is being taken'.
explanation.hi: 'is taking' Present Continuous है। Passive voice में 'is/am/are + being + V3' का उपयोग होता है। 'A selfie' एकवचन है, इसलिए 'is being taken' का उपयोग होगा।

question.en: Change the following sentence into Passive Voice: 'They were painting the doors.'
question.hi: निम्नलिखित वाक्य को Passive Voice में बदलें: 'They were painting the doors.'

en: The doors were being painted by them.
The doors was being painted by them.
The doors were painted by them.
The doors had been painted by them.
hi: The doors were being painted by them.
The doors was being painted by them.
The doors were painted by them.
The doors had been painted by them.

explanation.en: 'were painting' is Past Continuous. 'the doors' is plural, so the passive form uses 'were being painted' (were + being + V3).
explanation.hi: 'were painting' Past Continuous है। 'the doors' बहुवचन है, इसलिए passive रूप में 'were being painted' (were + being + V3) का उपयोग होगा।

question.en: Change the following interrogative sentence into Passive Voice: 'Has anyone answered your question?'
question.hi: निम्नलिखित प्रश्नवाचक वाक्य को Passive Voice में बदलें: 'Has anyone answered your question?'

en: Has your question been answered?
Have your question been answered?
Was your question answered?
Had your question been answered?
hi: Has your question been answered?
Have your question been answered?
Was your question answered?
Had your question been answered?

explanation.en: For Present Perfect interrogative, the passive structure is: Has/Have + Object + been + V3? Since 'your question' is singular, we use 'Has'.
explanation.hi: Present Perfect interrogative के लिए, passive structure है: Has/Have + Object + been + V3? चूंकि 'your question' एकवचन है, इसलिए हम 'Has' का उपयोग करते हैं।

question.en: Change the following interrogative sentence into Passive Voice: 'Had they completed the project before the deadline?'
question.hi: निम्नलिखित प्रश्नवाचक वाक्य को Passive Voice में बदलें: 'Had they completed the project before the deadline?'

en: Had the project been completed before the deadline?
Was the project completed before the deadline?
Has the project been completed before the deadline?
Had the project completed before the deadline?
hi: Had the project been completed before the deadline?
Was the project completed before the deadline?
Has the project been completed before the deadline?
Had the project completed before the deadline?

explanation.en: For Past Perfect interrogative, the passive structure is: Had + Object + been + V3?
explanation.hi: Past Perfect interrogative के लिए, passive structure है: Had + Object + been + V3?

question.en: Change the following sentence into Passive Voice: 'Who will pay the bill?'
question.hi: निम्नलिखित वाक्य को Passive Voice में बदलें: 'Who will pay the bill?'

en: By whom will the bill be paid?
Who will be paid the bill?
By whom would the bill be paid?
By whom will the bill paid?
hi: By whom will the bill be paid?
Who will be paid the bill?
By whom would the bill be paid?
By whom will the bill paid?

explanation.en: 'Who' changes to 'By whom' in passive voice. The structure for Future Simple interrogative is: By whom + will/shall + Object + be + V3?
explanation.hi: Passive voice में 'Who' बदलकर 'By whom' हो जाता है। Future Simple interrogative के लिए structure है: By whom + will/shall + Object + be + V3?

question.en: Change the following interrogative sentence into Passive Voice: 'Does he help the poor?'
question.hi: निम्नलिखित प्रश्नवाचक वाक्य को Passive Voice में बदलें: 'Does he help the poor?'

en: Are the poor helped by him?
Is the poor helped by him?
Were the poor helped by him?
Are the poor being helped by him?
hi: Are the poor helped by him?
Is the poor helped by him?
Were the poor helped by him?
Are the poor being helped by him?

explanation.en: 'the poor' is a plural collective noun. For Present Simple interrogative, we use: Is/Am/Are + Object + V3 + by + Subject? Thus, 'Are the poor helped...' is correct.
explanation.hi: 'the poor' एक बहुवचन सामूहिक संज्ञा (plural collective noun) है। Present Simple interrogative के लिए, हम उपयोग करते हैं: Is/Am/Are + Object + V3 + by + Subject? इस प्रकार, 'Are the poor helped...' सही है।

question.en: Change the following interrogative sentence into Passive Voice: 'Did you write this letter?'
question.hi: निम्नलिखित प्रश्नवाचक वाक्य को Passive Voice में बदलें: 'Did you write this letter?'

en: Was this letter written by you?
Is this letter written by you?
Had this letter been written by you?
Was this letter being written by you?
hi: Was this letter written by you?
Is this letter written by you?
Had this letter been written by you?
Was this letter being written by you?

explanation.en: 'Did' indicates Past Simple. The passive interrogative structure is: Was/Were + Object + V3 + by + Subject? 'this letter' is singular, so we use 'Was'.
explanation.hi: 'Did' Past Simple को दर्शाता है। Passive interrogative structure है: Was/Were + Object + V3 + by + Subject? 'this letter' एकवचन है, इसलिए हम 'Was' का उपयोग करते हैं।

question.en: Change the following interrogative sentence into Passive Voice: 'Will they have finished the task by tomorrow?'
question.hi: निम्नलिखित प्रश्नवाचक वाक्य को Passive Voice में बदलें: 'Will they have finished the task by tomorrow?'

en: Will the task have been finished by tomorrow?
Will the task be finished by tomorrow?
Would the task have been finished by tomorrow?
Will the task have finished by tomorrow?
hi: Will the task have been finished by tomorrow?
Will the task be finished by tomorrow?
Would the task have been finished by tomorrow?
Will the task have finished by tomorrow?

explanation.en: For Future Perfect interrogative, the passive structure is: Will/Shall + Object + have been + V3 + by + Subject?
explanation.hi: Future Perfect interrogative के लिए, passive structure है: Will/Shall + Object + have been + V3 + by + Subject?

question.en: Identify the correct statement regarding the passive voice of: 'He has been teaching English for ten years.'
question.hi: निम्नलिखित वाक्य के passive voice के संबंध में सही कथन की पहचान करें: 'He has been teaching English for ten years.'

en: No passive voice is possible for this sentence.
English has been being taught by him for ten years.
English is being taught by him for ten years.
Ten years have been taught English by him.
hi: No passive voice is possible for this sentence.
English has been being taught by him for ten years.
English is being taught by him for ten years.
Ten years have been taught English by him.

explanation.en: The sentence is in the Present Perfect Continuous tense, which does not have a passive voice form.
explanation.hi: यह वाक्य Present Perfect Continuous tense में है, जिसका passive voice रूप नहीं होता है।

question.en: Which of the following tenses does NOT have a passive voice form?
question.hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस काल (tense) का passive voice रूप नहीं होता है?

en: Future Continuous
Future Simple
Future Perfect
Past Continuous
hi: Future Continuous
Future Simple
Future Perfect
Past Continuous

explanation.en: According to English grammar rules, Future Continuous, Present Perfect Continuous, Past Perfect Continuous, and Future Perfect Continuous tenses do not have passive voice forms.
explanation.hi: अंग्रेजी व्याकरण के नियमों के अनुसार, Future Continuous, Present Perfect Continuous, Past Perfect Continuous और Future Perfect Continuous tenses के passive voice रूप नहीं होते हैं।
